package.name: defined_bringup
package.description:
Top-level launch orchestration for Defined Robotics.
Also provides platform_interface.py — the middleware-agnostic boundary types (RobotCommand, RobotState, NavigationGoal) that defined_rdf, defined_compiler, and the dashboard speak. No ROS2 types appear in that module; the ROS2 adapter nodes translate to/from it.
